resolution.desc: A structured verify → assign → resolve → close workflow keeps requests moving instead of sitting in an inbox.

register.q: How do I register a complaint?
register.a: Select "Citizen" on the home page, log in or register, then choose "Report a Complaint" from your dashboard. Fill in the category, description, address, and optionally a photo, then submit.

track.q: How do I track my complaint?
track.a: Open "My Requests" on your citizen dashboard and select the complaint. You'll see its full status history — registered, verified, assigned, in progress, completed, and closed.

appointment.q: How do I request an appointment?
appointment.a: From your citizen dashboard, choose "Book an Appointment", pick a department, and describe your purpose. An officer will confirm a date and time slot once it's assigned.

free.a: Yes, for citizens the platform is free to use for registering complaints, tracking requests, and booking appointments.

notifications.a: You'll see in-app notifications whenever your request changes status — verified, assigned, completed — right on your dashboard.
